# Vaibhav Gupta — Software Engineer & Systems Builder
> Personal Website & Technical Writing Archive: https://vaibhv19.dev

## Overview
Vaibhav Gupta is a Software Engineer specializing in distributed systems, AI agent platforms, hybrid retrieval (RAG), and full-stack architecture. He builds open-source developer tooling, experiments with multi-model AI orchestration, and writes in-depth technical essays on systems design, engineering trade-offs, and software architecture.

## Primary Navigation
- Home: https://vaibhv19.dev/ (Recent technical essays and profile summary)
- About: https://vaibhv19.dev/about (Engineering background, philosophy, influences, and live building activity)
- Posts Archive: https://vaibhv19.dev/posts (Chronological archive of technical essays and system retrospectives)
- My Work (Systems Portfolio): https://mywork.vaibhv19.dev (Interactive systems catalog, project breakdowns, and architecture deep-dives)
- Contact: https://vaibhv19.dev/about#get-in-touch (Direct email dispatch endpoint)

## Key Projects & Engineering Focus
- **Phoenix**: Hybrid RAG retrieval engine combining dense vector search (pgvector) with sparse lexical search (BM25) and reciprocal rank fusion.
- **Conclave**: Multi-model agent debate workspace orchestrating local Ollama instances and cloud endpoints over real-time STOMP WebSockets.
- **Vigil**: AI agent safety harness executing agent tool calls inside ephemeral Docker containers with system call interception.
- **Foundry**: Multi-agent startup architecture evaluation framework using LangGraph and Celery worker clusters.
- **Cairn**: Distributed in-memory caching engine built from first principles in Java 21 using virtual threads and consistent hashing.
- **Shard**: Distributed non-blocking caching cluster implemented in Python asyncio.
- **Trajectory**: Job application tracking platform on Spring Boot REST microservices, PostgreSQL, and React.
